entries.name: Madras Veterinary College Teaching Hospital (TANUVAS)
entries.duty: OPD 8:00-13:00 on working days (8:00-11:30 on holidays). Emergency and Critical Care unit for large and small animals runs round the clock.

duty_i18n.fr: Consultations externes 8 h–13 h les jours ouvrables (8 h–11 h 30 les jours fériés). Unité d’urgences et de soins intensifs pour grands et petits animaux ouverte en continu.
duty_i18n.es: Consultas externas (OPD) de 8:00 a 13:00 h en días laborables (de 8:00 a 11:30 h en festivos). Unidad de urgencias y cuidados críticos para animales grandes y pequeños las 24 horas.
duty_i18n.it: OPD (ambulatorio) 8:00–13:00 nei giorni lavorativi (8:00–11:30 nei festivi). Unità di pronto soccorso e terapia intensiva per animali grandi e piccoli attiva 24 ore su 24.
duty_i18n.pt: Consulta externa (OPD) 8h00–13h00 em dias úteis (8h00–11h30 em feriados). Unidade de urgência e cuidados intensivos para grandes e pequenos animais aberta 24 horas por dia.

entries.note: dir_cli.php: 'Emergency services for both large and small animals are available round the clock' at the Resident Veterinary Services Section; 'A separate Emergency and Critical Care unit functions round the clock'. Page gives no street address (Vepery, Chennai) and no phone; phone from tanuvas.ac.in/contacts.php (Teaching Hospital). viftanuvas.org/animal-healthcare-services-at-tanuvas also says 24x7 care at MVC hospital. Emergency unit phone not published (email rvomvc@tanuvas.org.in).

duty_i18n.pt: Consulta externa (OPD) segunda a sexta 8h00–13h00; sábado, domingo e feriados oficiais 8h00–11h30.

notes: India: 49 entries, 29 marked 24 h. No official clinic registry exists to cross-check: the Veterinary Council of India and state vet councils register individual practitioners (Indian Veterinary Council Act 1984), not clinics, so 24-h clinics were found via their own sites and university hospital pages. No official duty rota found (no Notdienst-style system). No animal poison information line found: AIIMS National Poisons Information Centre (1800 116 117) and CMC Vellore poison centre (1800 425 1213) were opened but serve humans and do not say they take animal calls, so not listed as poison_line. Skipped (robots disallowed or unusable): anihealpetvet.com (Jaipur 24/7), sanchuanimalhospital.com contact page (Sanchu 24x7 Bengaluru/Chennai/Coimbatore), barksandmeowspetclinic.com (Coimbatore). Not opened/usable: Max Vets (Delhi/Gurugram, maxvets.com returned empty pages), Friendicoes SECA (night clinic suspended per own site; contact page failed), BSPCA Parel hospital (no own site found; news only), Fairy Tails Goa (only a press page, no phone), Goa Dog Foundation clinics (page failed), Delhi government 24x7 hospital (only a blog), KVAFSU Hebbal vet hospital (no clinic page), Tritails/Cadovet (no address or phone), PetHouse Lucknow/Chandigarh pages (no local clinic), vetic.in/practo/justdial aggregators ignored. Cities still missing or thin: Goa, Surat, Nagpur, Lucknow, Bhopal, Patna, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Kochi beyond two, Mumbai beyond Tata/Crown/Cessna, Delhi beyond Zigly/Crown, Gurugram, Bengaluru 24 h beyond Cessna/Crown, Kolkata beyond Pups & Kits, Pune beyond Crown, Hyderabad beyond Seven Oaks/Crown.
